text: Batteries: valve-regulated lead-acid (VRLA) or nickel-cadmium with design life of at least 12 years, in separate rooms with a room temperature of 15 to 25 degC and ventilation for hydrogen (below 1 % H2 at any time, per IEC 60079-10-1 zoning of battery rooms). The 220 V DC voltage window is 187 to 242 V at the loads; the end-of-discharge voltage per cell shall be checked against the 187 V limit.
